rules.applies_when: a callable interface is added or changed
actions: define ownership lifetime thread safety and reentrancy
acceptance: all external inputs are validated before use
no ambiguous ownership or ignored mandatory error
all affected callers compile and pass regression
rules.failure_policy: block interface integration until contract is complete

actions: measure or bound Ci under the target build
include B J and higher-priority interference in deadline analysis
acceptance: no blocking wait sleep heap allocation formatted logging flash access or protocol parsing in ISR
all shared data uses documented synchronization
C+B+J plus interference is within the project deadline
U_isr is within the project CPU budget
rules.failure_policy: reject unsafe ISR change; missing event-rate target-build or timing data remains UNKNOWN

actions: calculate capacity at least ceil(R_peak*T_block)+F_max and apply stricter DMA framing requirements
apply cache maintenance when target requires it
required_evidence: full plus one overflow and wrap tests
acceptance: every read/write index is range-checked
producer cannot overwrite unread critical data without declared policy
buffer capacity covers the declared peak and stall window
buffer lifetime exceeds active transfer
cache behavior is verified or explicitly UNKNOWN
rules.failure_policy: stop integration on corruption risk; retain raw failing sequence

rules.applies_when: two contexts can access one state or peripheral
actions: assign single owner or synchronization primitive
define queue capacity and full policy
acceptance: no unprotected shared mutable state
no infinite wait busy loop or unbounded retry
safety messages have defined priority and loss policy
rules.failure_policy: block concurrent path and preserve existing working behavior

rules.applies_when: external bytes are parsed or produced
actions: validate header version length command and checksum in order
check remaining length before each field
handle fragmentation concatenation timeout duplicate and unknown extension
required_evidence: valid boundary malformed and recovery vectors
acceptance: malformed frame cannot cause out-of-bounds access or permanent parser stall
multi-byte fields have explicit endianness sign scale and unit
unknown extension follows documented compatibility behavior
rules.failure_policy: reject frame record bounded diagnostic and reset parser state

rules.applies_when: persistent data is read or written
actions: validate version length checksum and ranges before use
calculate lifetime writes as lifetime_seconds/minimum_write_interval times worst_write_amplification
write inactive record then read back verify then commit then switch active record or prove an equivalent atomic sequence
required_evidence: endurance calculation with units and source
acceptance: invalid data reaches a safe default or explicit error
old supported version migrates deterministically
every injected interruption leaves at least one recognizable valid old or new record
estimated writes remain within the project endurance budget
rules.failure_policy: preserve recoverable old data and block release on unhandled version or unproven power-loss point

actions: exercise interrupted update boot failure and rollback
acceptance: unsigned wrong-target corrupt or disallowed-downgrade image is rejected
previous bootable image survives failed activation
boot success is confirmed before permanent commit
rules.failure_policy: remain on or restore last verified image

acceptance: current target build exits zero and all declared artifacts exist
required regression passes
resource conclusions use current MAP/ELF or remain UNKNOWN
rules.failure_policy: retain failure and stale artifacts separately; do not claim target success
